title: Step 7 — Value Proposition
description: Define the unique value the solution will provide. Articulate why users would choose this solution over alternatives and what differentiates it.

who.description: What characterizes them (e.g., 'have ideas but struggle to structure them').

that.description: What the product does for them.

unlike.description: Positioning against the primary alternative (e.g., 'Unlike [competitor], our product...').

result.description: The end result for the user — the transformation.
